js: (async () => { const s = await window.api.settings.get(); await window.api.settings.set({ llmProvider: 'custom', customBaseUrl: 'http://127.0.0.1:18777/v1', llmModels: { ...s.llmModels, custom: 'mock-model' } }); window.__klikKartu = (judul) => { const art = [...document.querySelectorAll('article')].find((a) => a.textContent.includes(judul)); if (!art) return false; const btn = art.querySelector('button'); if (!btn) return false; btn.click(); return true; }; window.__klikTombol = (teks) => { const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find((x) => x.textContent.trim() === teks); if (!b) return false; b.click(); return true; }; console.log('FOKUS-SETUP ok'); })()

(async () => { const b = await window.api.projects.create({ synopsis: 'Uji fokus status hilang.', durationSec: 1200 }); window.__p = b.project.id; try { await window.api.story.script(window.__p); } catch (e) { console.log('FOKUS-PARTIAL gagal (diharapkan)'); } const after = await window.api.projects.get(window.__p); await window.api.projects.save({ project: { ...after.project, title: 'FOKUS Status' }, characters: after.characters, clips: after.clips }); console.log('FOKUS-PARTIAL tersimpan=' + after.clips.length); })()

(async () => { const list = await window.api.projects.list(); const p = list.find((x) => x.title === 'FOKUS Status'); window.__p = p ? p.id : null; console.log('FOKUS-PULIH p=' + window.__p + ' klikKartu=' + window.__klikKartu('FOKUS Status')); })()

(() => { const h1 = document.querySelector('h1') ? document.querySelector('h1').textContent : ''; console.log('FOKUS-HALAMAN h1=' + h1 + ' status60=' + document.body.innerText.includes('Tersimpan 60 dari 218 adegan') + ' klikLanjut=' + window.__klikTombol('Lanjutkan naskah')); })()

(async () => { const b = await window.api.projects.get(window.__p); const ada = document.body.innerText.includes('Tersimpan'); const pembawa = [...document.querySelectorAll('body *')].filter((el) => el.children.length === 0 && el.textContent.includes('Tersimpan')).map((el) => el.tagName + '.' + String(el.className).slice(0, 60) + ' :: ' + el.textContent.slice(0, 120)); console.log('FOKUS-SELESAI adegan=' + b.clips.length + ' Tersimpan-di-innerText=' + ada + ' pembawa=' + JSON.stringify(pembawa)); })()
